cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, participant_distance, _deliver, Router, _candidate_orders, _adjacency, _decompose_trees
for f in ['fails_small_31.json','fails_big_32.json']:
    for case in json.load(open(f)):
        n, links, caps, parts, r = case
        r = {int(k): v for k,v in r.items()}
        parts = [(p[0], r[p[0]]) for p in parts]
        links = [tuple(l) for l in links]
        print('=== case', n, links, caps, parts, r)
        dist=participant_distance(n,links,parts,caps)
        names=[p[0] for p in parts]
        for (v,rv) in parts:
            if rv<=0: continue
            router=Router(n,links,caps); recipes=[];memo={}
            outcomes=[]
            for order in _candidate_orders(v,[w for w in names if w!=v],dist,_adjacency(n,links,caps,parts)[0],set(names))[:8]:
                saved=list(router.res)
                res=_deliver(router,v,rv,order,names,n,dist,recipes,memo)
                if res is None:
                    outcomes.append('D'); router.res=saved; continue
                recs=_decompose_trees(v,rv,res[0],parts)
                outcomes.append('ok' if recs else 'X')
                router.res=saved
                if recs: break
            print('  origin',v,rv,''.join(outcomes))
" 2>&1 | head -40
